rounds.prompt: Which part of the ear vibrates when sound arrives?
rounds.explain: The eardrum vibrates when sound waves hit it.

rounds.prompt: Match each ear part to its job.
rounds.explain: The ear passes sound from pinna to brain.
The brain compares both ears to find direction.
It amplifies sound for weak hearing.
